name: Bronzebeard Encampment
summary: In southern Silithus, Bronzebeard Encampment keeps a dwarven foothold east of the Scarab Wall. Explorer's League researchers study ancient silithid glyphs and mysteries buried beneath the desert.

sections.title: A Foothold in the Shifting Sands
sections.body: Bronzebeard Encampment stands near Silithus's southern bluffs, within sight of the Scarab Wall. Ironforge founded the camp for archaeological work. Researchers Rutgar Glyphshaper and Frankal Stonebridge study inscriptions and monuments left by forgotten civilizations. Scorching heat, scorpids, and silithid swarms make their work dangerous.

sections.title: Glyphs and Desperation
sections.body: At Bronzebeard Encampment, study goes hand in hand with survival. Silithid threats spread from underground hives, and the monstrous scorpid Deathclasp prowls nearby. Researchers rely on visiting adventurers to bring back rubbings of obscure glyphs, decipher ancient insectoid tongues, and find companions lost in the desert.

faq.q: Where is the Bronzebeard Encampment located?
faq.answer: Bronzebeard Encampment lies in southern Silithus, east of the Scarab Wall and north of the southern mountain ridge.
Members and associates of the dwarven Explorer's League staff the camp. They include glyph researcher Rutgar Glyphshaper, Frankal Stonebridge, and their companion Glibb.

faq.q: What are the dwarves studying here?
faq.answer: The researchers study ancient stone glyphs, the silithid communication system, and long-buried secrets of southern Kalimdor.

faq.q: What threats lurk near the encampment?
faq.answer: Aggressive silithid bugs, sand scorpions, and Deathclasp prowl the surrounding desert. Deathclasp is the giant scorpid known as Terror of the Sands, and nests just to the southeast.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see the Explorer's League's tenacity at work in this harsh desert. Ironforge researchers seek historical truth here.
As an Alliance traveler in Silithus, you can find a friendly camp far south of Cenarion Hold.
